{{Top|leg|title=''Sevinte'' cadence}}
The '''''sevinte'' cadence''' was a type of [[Cadence/Legends|cadence]] where the [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|strikes]] were carried out within a hands-breadth of the opponent. In the "Introduction to the Lightsaber" section of the ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', the [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Skarch Vaunk]] wrote that a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] was not ready for a real [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] unless they completed ''sevinte'' cadence.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>
